subject: SIG: follow-up on SCIM / SAML mappings and least-privilege RBAC
messages:
From: Emily Chen <emily.chen@bluewavehealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: security+vendor@bluewavehealth.com
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: SIG follow-up: SCIM group mapping + least-privilege RBAC

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for the initial SIG bundle you sent last week. Our security team had two quick follow-ups while reviewing the access controls section:

1) For SCIM provisioning, do you support per-group push mappings (i.e., push specific groups rather than full-directory sync)? We need to know whether BlueWave can provision just the "clinical-users" and "analytics" groups without provisioning other org units.

2) Regarding RBAC, can you provide the canonical RBAC matrix that shows which Redwood roles map to model access (inference vs. admin), ability to view logs, and ability to modify deployment configs? We want to validate least-privilege assignments.

If possible, can you also confirm whether MFA is enforced for admin console access and what second factors are supported?

We'd appreciate a short reply and any attachments you can share.

Thanks,
Emily
Emily Chen
Security Ops Manager
BlueWave Health

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Chen <emily.chen@bluewavehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SIG follow-up: SCIM group mapping + least-privilege RBAC

Emily — thanks for the clear questions. Short answers up front, details and attachments below.

- SCIM: yes, we support scoped/group push provisioning. You can push a subset of groups from your IdP; our connector accepts group filter rules (by group name or externalId). I've attached a diagram (redwood_scim_flow.png) and the attribute mapping table.

- RBAC matrix: attached (rbac-matrix.csv). It maps our built-in roles (viewer, developer, operator, admin) to capabilities: inference_call, view_audit_logs, edit_deployment, change_billing. For least-privilege we recommend starting with viewer/developer for application teams and only granting operator/admin to infra owners.

- MFA: MFA is required for console access for any role with edit_deployment or change_billing. We support TOTP (e.g., Authenticator apps), WebAuthn (hardware keys), and optional SMS OTP for break-glass scenarios (SMS is audit-flagged).

Next steps: Soojin (cc'd) will add security notes about session timeouts and privileged access review cadence. Vivek will confirm exact SCIM attributes (externalId, groups, displayName, emails) accepted by our connector.

I'll send the SAML metadata and a compact answers document by EOD.

— Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Chen <emily.chen@bluewavehealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 02 Dec 2026 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SIG follow-up: SCIM group mapping + least-privilege RBAC

Hi Emily — adding the security detail Karthik promised.

1) SCIM provisioning scope:
- We support group-level scoping: provisioning can be configured to create/update/delete only members of specified groups. You can provide group filter expressions from the IdP side (e.g., group.displayName startsWith "clinical-").
- Supported attributes: userName, externalId, givenName, familyName, displayName, emails (primary), active, groups (memberships). We also accept custom attributes (X-Redwood-Role) if you need role tagging.
- Deprovisioning behavior: when a user is removed from the provisioned group, we can either suspend the account (default) or soft-delete per your preference. Suspension preserves logs and data bindings for compliance.

2) RBAC and least privilege:
- Built-in roles: viewer, developer, operator, admin.
- Key mappings (summary):
  * viewer — inference_call, view_metrics (no log access)
  * developer — inference_call, view_metrics, create_routes (no deployment edits)
  * operator — all developer permissions + edit_deployment, view_audit_logs
  * admin — full (includes billing and organization settings)
- We recommend: app teams -> developer, data platform -> operator, security/infra -> admin.
- Role change audit: all role assignments are recorded in audit logs (timestamp, actor, justification field) and retained 13 months by default (longer retention available as add-on).

3) MFA and session controls:
- MFA required for roles operator/admin; optional for developer/viewer.
- Supported second factors: TOTP (RFC 6238), WebAuthn (FIDO2), and SMS OTP for emergency.
- Session timeout: console sessions default to 8 hours for elevated roles, 24 hours for viewer/developer. Idle timeout 30 minutes.

4) Evidence and logs:
- We can provide a sanitized export of audit logs for role assignments and console logins. For SIG evidence, we'll provide redacted sample audit records and a description of where live logs are stored (S3 with SSE-KMS and access via customer-managed roles).

I've attached the RBAC CSV and a short SAML configuration guide. Let me know if you want a quick call to walk through SCIM filters.

Regards,
Soojin Lee
Security & Compliance Lead | Redwood Inference

From: Emily Chen <emily.chen@bluewavehealth.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 04 Dec 2026 10:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SIG follow-up: SCIM group mapping + least-privilege RBAC

Thanks — helpful. A couple quick clarifications after reviewing the attachments:

- For SCIM: does the connector support incremental sync and lastModified filtering to avoid full re-syncs nightly? BlueWave needs near-real-time updates for onboarding clinicians.
- For RBAC: can you confirm whether "operator" role can view API keys for a team (we want to ensure billing/admin keys are restricted)?

If you can answer those two points we can close this section of the SIG. If not, we can hop on a 20-minute call next week.

Best,
Emily

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Chen <emily.chen@bluewavehealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 07 Dec 2026 14:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SIG follow-up: SCIM group mapping + least-privilege RBAC

Hi Emily — quick technical clarifications from infra: 

- Incremental SCIM sync: yes. The connector supports incremental syncs via lastModified and uses delta tokens from the IdP when available. Default behavior for group pushes is near-real-time (events-driven when your IdP supports SCIM/Webhooks) and we fall back to incremental polling every 5 minutes. Full re-syncs are only triggered by schema changes or explicit admin action.

- API key visibility: operator role cannot view organization-level billing or platform admin API keys. Operators can view team-level keys only if explicitly granted; by default keys are masked and require admin approval to reveal. All key reveal actions are recorded in the audit log and require MFA if the requester is not the original key owner.

If you'd like, I can schedule a 20-minute technical drop-in with our SCIM engineer to validate your IdP mappings (we've done Okta, Azure AD, and OneLogin integrations).

Cheers,
Vivek Kulkarni
Principal Infrastructure Engineer | Redwood Inference
